In this article, we provide you with information on the best window film options we offer for privacy. Tint a Home is Australia’s most trusted home tinting specialist, providing tinting solutions in Australia for over 42 years. We offer a lifetime warranty on most of our films and installations are done by professional installers. Learn more about the best window films for privacy at night, and get the answers to what is the best window film for day and night privacy?

Our Range Of The Best Window Tints For Privacy

  • Solar Film
    With an option to choose a reflective film that turns your windows into a mirror, this film is one of the best window films for privacy as it ensures those on the outside cannot see within. Solar Film also offers other benefits too including a dramatic reduction in UV rays and year round comfort with a more consistent room temperature which can make a positive difference to your power bills.
  • Decorative Film
    This opaque frosted film is one of the best window films for privacy at night. Even when it’s dark outside and lights are on inside, it prevents those on the outside from seeing inside. It’s particularly ideal for bathrooms and you can even add a bit of creative flair to your home with customised designs applied to the film.
